sections.value: CERTIFICATE OF ELECTRONIC GENERATED EVIDENCE PURSUANT TO {{section}} OF THE EVIDENCE ACT, ___
I {{deponentDetails}} , do hereby make oath and state as follows;
This certificate is made in respect of the following electronic evidence:
1. The above-mentioned documents were sent from my {{deviceUsed}} to the {{printerOrOutputDevice}} and printed into physical copies.
2. The document containing the statement was produced by the computer during a period over which the computer was used regularly to store or process information.

3. Over that period, information of the kind contained in the statement, or of the kind from which the information so contained is derived, was regularly supplied to the computer in the ordinary course of those activities.
4. Throughout the material part of that period, the computer was operating properly.
5. The information contained in the statement reproduces, or is derived from, information supplied to the computer in the ordinary course of those activities.
These documents are material to this suit.
I make this statement in good faith, conscientiously believing the same to be true and in accordance with the Oaths Act, 2004.
